scope: user_001 existing 41-character development and 42-character observed regression; no fresh validation claim
training: only existing train-only retained-source profile; grouped by character before any averaging
features: public full-glyph normalized bbox component center x/y divided by 0.85, log(width/0.85)/2, log(height/0.85)/2, log(stroke count)/4
response: source component center minus public component center and log source/public max-span ratio, using complete source points
prediction: exclude target character and every repeat; exact component context first, otherwise role plus parent layout; up to 8 nearest distinct characters within feature distance 0.5; minimum 4; median within character then median across characters
limits: abstain if center residual norm >0.15 or span ratio outside [2/3,1.5]; never clip predicted output

arms.L_D: D donor fixed; blend old placement center/log span with training prediction
arms.L_H: H donor fixed; identical target prediction and strength

geometry: one common positive isotropic scale and translation for all donor strokes; no averaging raw trajectories, per-stroke output fitting or source changes
safety: existing invariants, no new strict interstroke crossing versus A, each stroke length/A length in [0.4,2.5]; otherwise exact original D/H placement
development_selection: choose lowest mean geometry among learned/public arms and strengths with geometry strictly below D, mean terminal angle <=D+0.5 degrees, each character geometry <=1.05*D, each stroke maximum local error averaged across captures <=D+0.005, same source activation; ties smaller strength then P_D,L_D,P_H,L_H; otherwise D
interpretation: training data can jointly supply donor and layout model; layout prediction is not independent naturalness evidence; target originals only evaluated after all outputs fixed

controls.P_D: D donor fixed, public normalized component layout, same strengths
controls.P_H: H donor fixed, public normalized component layout, same strengths
